root_cause.text: In the `mcba_usb_read_bulk_callback()` function, the URB is not re-anchored to `priv->rx_submitted` after the USB core unanchors it upon completion, causing completed URBs to be leaked when the driver tries to free all anchored URBs during shutdown via `usb_kill_anchored_urbs()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &priv->rx_submitted);` before resubmission, and the commit message explicitly states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in usb_kill_anchored_urbs()."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing URB anchoring in mcba_usb_read_bulk_callback to properly track submitted URBs and prevent resource leaks on device disconnect.
intent_record.what: Added usb_anchor_urb before submitting URB, and usb_unanchor_urb on failure; added early return on success; changed error condition from else if (retval) to else.
intent_record.how: The URB is now anchored to priv->rx_submitted before submission, ensuring it is tracked for proper cleanup. On successful submission, the function returns early. On failure, the URB is unanchored to release the reference. The error message is now printed for any non-zero retval (since success returns early).
